title: Cohort roles, analytic denominators, and validation availability
content: Cohort, tier, manuscript role, source-screen N, complete-domain N, endotype N, selected class count, functional validation N/events, mortality N/deaths.
clinical_purpose: Prevents denominator mixing and shows which cohorts support clinical validation.
precision_rule: Do not combine source-screen, complete-domain and validation denominators; LASI validation is unavailable, not zero events.

title: Clinical endotype families and interpretation
content: Family name, number of classes, participants, cohorts represented, functional-event range, death range, clinical reading.
clinical_purpose: Turns statistical classes into geriatric phenotypes without overclaiming treatment implications.
precision_rule: Full class-level dictionary remains supplementary; main table summarizes clinically stable families.

title: Primary functional validation and mortality guardrail metrics
content: Endpoint, N, events, event percent, endotype fit, continuous four-domain fit, fit delta, AUC delta.
clinical_purpose: Shows clinical validation strength and the comparator guardrail.
precision_rule: Functional deterioration is primary; mortality is secondary and guarded by PH/piecewise checks.

title: Clinical study flow and tier structure
content: Seven-cohort source screen, complete-domain construction, strict/bridge split, six-cohort functional validation and mortality validation.
clinical_purpose: Makes the seven-construction/six-validation design immediately clear.
precision_rule: Figure must label LASI as baseline-only and KLoSA as bridge.

title: Four-domain clinical profile heatmap for selected endotypes
content: Rows are cohort-specific classes; columns are functional, cognitive, affective and cardiometabolic z-scores; row labels include N percent and clinical family.
clinical_purpose: The main discovery figure: what the endotypes look like clinically.
precision_rule: Use oriented z-scores where higher means worse; avoid implying cross-cohort absolute equivalence.

title: Functional deterioration validation and comparator guardrail
content: Panel A: minimally adjusted ORs by endotype class within cohort. Panel B: continuous four-domain comparator deltas by cohort.
clinical_purpose: Shows whether clinically interpretable classes also separate primary functional deterioration risk.
precision_rule: Report within-cohort comparisons only; do not interpret class ORs as pooled causal effects.

title: Harmonization, model selection, full metrics and guardrails
content: Domain dictionary, GMM selection, full validation metrics, mortality sensitivity guardrails, SHARE strict audit, outcome-model specification, full clinical dictionary.
clinical_purpose: Gives reviewers enough audit surface without overcrowding the main paper.
precision_rule: Keep source-tier and denominator fields in every supplement that changes cohort inclusion.
